title: 第7章 消息第8章 风闻司
lines: “今天巡街感觉怎么样？”画酉晚堂的时候，田牧川关心地问了一句。
点卯早衙和画酉晚堂，分别是上下班打卡和开会...
“回大人，有陆大人教导，我已经熟悉了一些。”魏乐府跟着说道：“明日自己巡街不成问题。”
“不错。”田牧川点点头应了一句，而后说道：“今儿个让你们来晚堂，也是有事的。”
平时自然是点卯画酉之后就散衙了，没什么事肯定不开会。
“风闻司那边传来消息。”田牧川开口说道。
众人一听，神色也不由得凝重了起来，若不是重要的事情，都是直接通知，根本不用开会。
这次都要开会了，就足以说明其严重性。
“大云光明寺出了个叛徒，弑师叛门还盗走了门内的镇派传承之物。”田牧川说道：“根据风闻司所说，其路线有可能会经过咱们松阳县。”
“若是遇见了，切勿声张，回来报信即可。”
虽然打起来不一定会输，但松阳县加上新加入的魏乐府，铁尺捕快一共也就十二人。
损失一个对于田牧川来说都是伤筋动骨。
能练武的少，就算有练的那也是略有家财，还不如去科举。
不仅上限高还没有危险。
就算要加入六扇门，有这份资本也是去州府或者其他大点的地方，而不是选择松阳县。
当然，小地方也有小地方的好处。
魏乐府听到这话，也是心中一动，这个大云光明寺的叛徒会不会和他的任务目标有关系。
毕竟八宝金身怎么看都更像是佛家武学。
“大人，可还有什么消息吗？”陆翰墨进一步追问。
“有画像。”田牧川说着，拿出了一张画着人像的纸，却又说道：“不过也别有太大期望。”
“这玩意准不准都另说，更别提对方还会易容。”
“也不必刻意去寻找，若是找不到也就算了。”
田牧川也想要这份功劳，然而不说其他的，这人只是有可能会经过松阳县，又不是必定到。
“是，大人。”一众铁尺捕快听到这话，都松了一口气，齐齐回答。
“田大人，这被盗的传承之物是什么？”魏乐府借着这个机会问道。
“是一尊佛像。”田牧川倒是直接说道：“记载了八宝金身这门武学。”
“这般兴师动众，难不成这八宝金身很厉害？”魏乐府继续追问。
“天下武学都差不了多少，也不比其他武学厉害多少。”田牧川应完却是顿了一下说道：“不过总会有些较为特殊的武学。”
“这八宝金身便是其中一种了。”
“听说辅以修炼，可精纯气血强横体魄。”
“不过你们也别想着练，这门武学之所以会是大云光明寺的镇派武学是因为难练和贵。”
“一百人里一个人能入门那都是得天之幸了，但这还只是个开始，入门后的修炼还需要耗费大量资财和时间。”
“寻常人辅修这门武学，再加上练养打，怕是先把自己给练死了。”
一听这话，魏乐府就明白了，合着这门武学不仅挑人难练，还得氪金才行。
然后他就觉得这门武学，怎么看着像是专门留给主角的。
田牧川说的这些条件对于九成九人甚至田牧川自己来说都是个大门槛。
content_en:
"How do you feel about patrolling the streets today?" Tian Muchuan asked with concern during the evening party.
Dianmao morning office and Huayou evening hall are for clocking in and out and having meetings respectively...
"Sir, thanks to Master Lu's guidance, I have become somewhat familiar with it." Wei Yuefu followed up and said, "It won't be a problem to patrol the streets by myself tomorrow."
"That's right." Tian Muchuan nodded in agreement, and then said, "I asked you to come to the evening hall today because I have something to do."
Normally, it would be natural to leave the office after clicking Mao Huayou. If there is nothing to do, there would be no meeting.
"There's news from the Fengwen Department." Tian Muchuan said.
When everyone heard this, their expressions became solemn. If it was not an important matter, they would be notified directly and there would be no need to hold a meeting at all.
The fact that there is a meeting this time is enough to illustrate its seriousness.
"There is a traitor in Dayun Guangming Temple. He killed his master and rebelled against the sect and stole the inheritance of the sect within the sect." Tian Muchuan said: "According to the Rumor Division, its route may pass through our Songyang County."
"If you meet someone, don't make any noise about it, just come back and report it."
Although they may not necessarily lose in a fight, with the newly joined Wei Yuefu in Songyang County, there are only twelve Iron Ruler agents in total.
Losing one would be a traumatic experience for Tamakikawa.
There are few people who can practice martial arts, and even those who can practice martial arts only have a little wealth, so they might as well take the imperial examination.
Not only is the upper limit high, there is no danger.
Even if you want to join Liumen, if you have the capital, you should go to the state capital or other larger places instead of choosing Songyang County.
Of course, a small place also has its advantages.
When Wei Yuefu heard this, he also wondered whether this traitor from Dayun Guangming Temple might be related to his mission goal.
After all, the Eight Treasures Golden Body looks more like Buddhist martial arts.
"Sir, is there any news?" Lu Hanmo asked further.
"There are portraits." Tian Muchuan said, taking out a piece of paper with portraits on it, and then said, "But don't have high expectations."
"Whether this thing is accurate or not is another matter, not to mention that the other party can disguise himself."
"You don't have to look for it deliberately. If you can't find it, forget it."
Tian Muchuan also wanted this credit, but apart from other things, this person might pass through Songyang County, but he was not certain to arrive.
"Yes, sir." When all the Iron Rulers heard this, they all breathed a sigh of relief and answered in unison.
"Master Tian, ​​what is this stolen inheritance?" Wei Yuefu took this opportunity to ask.
"It's a Buddha statue." Tian Muchuan said directly: "It records the martial arts of the Eight Treasures Golden Body."
"With such a massive move of troops, is it possible that the Eight Treasures Golden Body is very powerful?" Wei Yuefu continued to ask.
"The martial arts in the world are not much different, and they are not much better than other martial arts." Tian Muchuan Yingwan paused and said, "But there will always be some more special martial arts."
"This Eight Treasures Golden Body is one of them."
"I heard that with the help of practice, you can refine your Qi and blood and dominate your body."
"But don't even think about practicing it. The reason why this martial arts is the martial arts of Dayun Guangming Temple is because it is difficult and expensive to practice."
"It's a blessing if one of a hundred people can get started, but this is just the beginning. Training after getting started will require a lot of money and time."
"Ordinary people who minor in this martial arts, plus practice and fight, will probably train themselves to death first."
As soon as he heard this, Wei Yuefu understood that co-authoring this martial arts was not only difficult to recruit, but also required a lot of money.
Then he felt that this martial arts seemed to be specially reserved for the protagonist.
These conditions mentioned by Tian Muchuan are a big threshold for 99% of people and even Tian Muchuan himself.
